## 简体中文

- 修复 beta.2 升级后因流量历史迁移校验值变化而导致服务无法启动、Web 界面不可访问的问题；仅接受已核实的等价历史校验值，未知修改仍会被拒绝。
- 流量历史保存时保留已经应用的迁移记录，避免正常记录流量后覆盖旧校验值，影响后续回滚。
- Windows 服务完成数据初始化和监听绑定后才上报 Running；安装器在提交更新前验证新版本 Web 健康接口，检查失败时停止新服务并回滚程序和 UI。
- 冻结已发布的 Rust 和 SQL 迁移源码，禁止在参与校验的迁移文件内放置测试，并增加自动检查及升级回归覆盖。

## English

- Fixed service startup and Web availability after upgrading from beta.2 when the traffic-history migration checksum changed. Only verified equivalent historical checksums are accepted; unknown changes remain rejected.
- Preserve applied migration records when saving traffic history, avoiding replacement of historical checksums during normal collection and preserving rollback compatibility.
- Report the Windows service as Running only after data initialization and listener binding. Verify the new version's Web health before committing an installation; stop the new service and roll back the program and UI if verification fails.
- Freeze published Rust and SQL migration sources, prohibit inline tests in checksummed migration files, and add automated enforcement and upgrade regression coverage.
